title: Offence: reserved trees outside reserves
rule: Felling, cutting, lopping, damaging, removing or selling a reserved tree on unreserved land without a licence, permit or lawful authority is an offence.
checks: The tree is a reserved tree
No licence, permit or lawful authority
penalty: Fine of TSh 50,000 to 1,000,000, or up to 1 year in prison, or both.
flag: Covers reserved trees only. Confirm with a legal officer whether s. 89 applies instead to other trees.
